name: How long does a final quality walkthrough usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a final quality walkthrough usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a final quality walkthrough can vary significantly based on the project's size and complexity. For a smaller renovation, it might take an hour or two, while a large custom home or commercial project could require several hours or even a full day. Frasheski Construction allocates sufficient time based on the project scope to ensure no detail is overlooked and all client questions are addressed thoroughly.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration varies by project size, from an hour for small renovations to several hours for larger projects, to ensure all details are covered.
